sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech

Indonesia's renewables growth hinges on PLN off-take reforms and carbon-market monetization; TOBA's upside depends on regulatory execution, not global price trends.
sectors.ai: Buy selective US renewables (RUN, ARRY, SEDG) and Korean solar (051910, 373220) on momentum, but trim Indonesia-exposed names (TOBA) as local policy remains slow. Pair long VST/CEG for stable power demand against volatile equipment makers. Rotate profits into names with confirmed order books; avoid chasing +7% spikes without volume confirmation.

sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap consumer names with confirmed volume breakouts (BWPT, SSMS, GZCO) and pair with liquid large-cap staples for downside protection. Momentum is broad but not euphoric—add on dips, avoid chasing +20% spikes without follow-through. Rotate into palm-oil-linked FMCG (BWPT) and regional snack/dairy plays (SSMS, GZCO) as rupiah stability supports input costs.

Position for Q4 peak-season freight and government port-efficiency reforms; trim US-exposed names.
